_infeasible_machines_comment: `infeasible_machines` is XPU-RT's own per-dispatch hard exclusion (workload_factory.parse_infeasible_combinations -> Operation.infeasible_combinations).  It names the machine(s) that did NOT run this dispatch, for one of two reasons recorded in `_cell_classes` and, per row, in the profile CSVs' `cell_class` column: excluded_impossible (illegal instruction there) or excluded_unmeasured (possible, never measured).  The matching profile row carries the 1e9 us SENTINEL_MS cost, so the cell is excluded twice over -- once as a constraint, once as a cost that is explicitly not a timing.  NOTE the index assumption: parse_infeasible_combinations maps a machine's index in `machines` onto a COMBINATION index, which is 1:1 only under machine_combination_mode=singletons with one core per kind. That is what this workload declares.  TO FILL AN UNMEASURED CELL: put the measured row in the CSV (cell_class=measured) AND drop that machine from this list.  Both, or the solver still cannot use it.
